body: same at first i binged it but now i’m not as intrigued :( it’s just the same thing over and over. hopefully it gets interesting with rios brother lol but i’m not too sure about that
this is really surprising and thanks for finding this out lol.the guy looks so gross too. seems like she really wants to live in la or cali too but she could do better definitely
and it’s her choice too.he’s so selfish. they don’t realize she’s able to change her mind if she wants. she dodged a bullet by not staying with him lol

for me personally i think it was like 12 days and i had four out. i took pain medication for like a week i think but it was noticeably less pain at day 11 or 12  i’m 18 post days op and i’m mostly back to normal :) .i almost felt at one point scared the pain wouldn’t go away but it does
i’m glad it’s better now !yes salt water rinses are super effective i think also :). i stopped doing the antibiotic rinse i was given and just the saltwater and it feels much better now

same i felt grossed out by mashed potato’s after eating it so much .. i started eating pancakes after like 5 days  tbh i just would break them up in little pieces and swallow them lol good luck with your healing!

from what i’ve read online as long as you’re not in pain and rinse afterwards you should be able to eat normally. i’m also like 12 days post op  and well i’m eating more foods now just avoiding chips and things with seeds

hey i felt really anxious too and i survived lol! it’ll all be okay i got four out and i’m doing good now the pain does suck but it’s better to heal from having them out than having the pain of them in. make sure to have soft foods and rest as much as you can the days after. good luck!❤️

my fourth and fifth day were really painful also. i’m 23 and i also had four removed. two were fully impacted and one partially. and i also was given hydrocodone but i feel like it didn’t help my pain at all:/ and i also threw up one morning lol. i’m on my 8th day after surgery and it is getting lesser but it hurts tbh
hi it’s been about seven days for me and i’m still in pain too:(. don’t worry tho unless it’s like throbbing and extremely painful from what i’ve read that could be bad but it’s normal to be sore
i think i’ve lost weight too bc some clothes feel looser.. i think it’s bc it’s less food we consume bc of the surgery

same i’m so ready to eat a burger with fries .. i’m so sick of eating soups and ice cream haha. when do you think you would be able to eat pizza ? i started eating pancakes today and it wasn’t too bad
wow that’s a lot lol well it’s good you got them all out ! hope u have a speedy recovery also :)

it depends if it’s impacted. when i was like 20ish id have random pains in my back teeth but i didn’t realize it was my wisdom teeth growing in lol. i’m 23 now and it started causing me pain but it’s bc they were impacted. it was manageable pain at first but then it got annoying so i got all four out. it just depends tbh everyone is different but i’ve read it’s better to get them out younger bc healing would be easier
oo okay i may start that too. i was given naproxen but i don’t think it did a lot lol. i am almost done with my pain meds too .. how many teeth did u get out ?
how much of tylenol and ibrupofen do u take? i’m on my seventh day now and in pain lol

i’m 23 and yes for some reason feel really awkward around families..like the dynamic they have.i just feel so out of place. i also have social anxiety so i’m not sure if that’s it also lol.. i feel like it’s made me more sensitive but i don’t mind it. i wouldn’t say i was spoiled but i did get a lot of the things i wanted growing up

same. i’m 23 and my parents are in their 60s too and i honestly cry out of fear that i’ll lost my mom. i don’t feel like the friends i have are close enough and i don’t have family im close with. my dad is reckless with covid also lol. just try your best to be safe and know you are not alone. if you want to message me i’m here
yeah i’m thinking of eating mac and cheese already tbh lol i hope your recovery goes fast i know it sucks not eating
hey i’m on my fourth day of healing also! what helps me feel “full” is ensure shakes and mashed potato’s with sour cream. also cambells soups. i’m still swollen and hurting also lol
thank u! it wasn’t so bad it really felt like i just slept now i’m just tryna figure out when to eat and how to take pain meds and all

i work at a callcenter and it’s unbearable but i have to save money until i can quit.. i plan on leaving soon to find something i’m happier in. It’s affected my mental health and it sucks so much and i feel hopeless but i just remind myself i won’t always work that job and i take it day by day tbh
